newsitem.title: USA: US Medical in talks to sell assets.
newsitem.headline: US Medical in talks to sell assets.

text.p: US Medical Products Inc said it has entered into negotiations to sell a majority of its assets to Hayes Medical Inc of Sacramento, Calif.
It said these assets include implant and instrument inventories, property and equipment, patents and regulatory approvals.
In addition to the assumption of certain liabilities, Hayes said it will pay US Medical using a combination of cash, royalties and a secured note.
